messages:
olivia_cs: Need a short proactive note to 4 high-touch onboarders impacted by this morning's embeddings ingest lag. Draft below  rapid review please. @matt_success @ravi_sre

matt_success: Call out a one-time pro-rated invoice adjustment and how customers will see it on their next statement. Also flag renewal owners for follow-up where risk is high.

ravi_sre: Ops summary: spike at ~08:40 UTC, routed impacted tenants to a warm reserved pool at 08:55 UTC. Backfill started 09:10 UTC; most queues cleared by 09:40 UTC. No cross-region movement; KV cache validated.

zoe_onboarding: I can own the enablement invite and follow-ups. Suggest offering two 30-min slots and capturing a short post-session feedback card.

dan_product: Recommend adding a sentence about short-term performance impact vs long-term data integrity to reassure compliance-sensitive customers.

olivia_cs: Draft email (send from cs@redwood):
"Hi <CustomerName>,

Were reaching out with a brief status update: we detected an increase in ingestion queueing for embeddings starting at ~08:40 UTC this morning. To protect throughput we temporarily routed affected workloads to reserved warm capacity; this cleared the backlog but you may notice slightly higher latency for a short period while we finish backfilling.

What were doing:
- Applied regional fallback to reserved warm capacity (completed).
- Running targeted retries/backfill to clear residual queued items (in progress).
- Performing an RCA; we will share findings within 48 hours.

Billing: We will apply a one-time pro-rated invoice adjustment to offset measurable impact during the affected window. Your CS contact will follow up with the exact amount and how it appears on your billing statement.

Offer: Wed like to offer a complimentary 30-minute tuning session to review ingest settings and batching patterns. Book here: <calendar-link>.

FAQ: Will my data move regions? No  routing remained inside your configured region and there is no data loss risk.

If you need urgent assistance, reply to this note or open a priority support request and we will escalate.

Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Customer Success"

matt_success: Approved. Ill notify renewal managers for the affected accounts.

zoe_onboarding: Ill DM each contact with the two slot options and log meeting notes + a 3-question feedback card after each session.

ravi_sre: Continuing RCA work; will post timeline and root cause artifacts in the incident ticket.

billing_bot: Billing adjustment queued for affected tenants; finance will post the pro-rated amount to next invoice run.

olivia_cs: Sending now. Will update thread with customer responses and any requests for credits or escalations.
